title: Renaming and removing
question: A name moves, a directory will not go while it has names in it, and a file goes when its last name does. What does ext4 do?

stops.note: In one directory: the entry's name changes, "a.txt" to "b.txt"; the inode stays as it is.
Is it empty? No ("b.txt"): the call fails, ENOTEMPTY.
The name leaves the directory block.
It was the file's only name, and nobody has it open: its inode is freed.
Now empty: the directory's block goes back to the block bitmap, and its inode is freed.
